commitResults.messageTitle: Clarify command parameter order in user guide
Prevent data loss from duplicate JSON properties
Fix name searches for punctuated names
commitResults.messageBody:
Name validation accepts punctuation, but searches miss words next to
punctuation and reject slash keywords such as S/O as field prefixes.
This makes valid member names harder to find.

Match complete name components next to punctuation while preserving
internal hyphens, apostrophes and slashes. Treat slash keywords as
literal names when no supported prefix is present, and retain strict
validation for prefixed searches.

Keep literal punctuated queries compatible with existing searches.
Align offline help and add regression tests for punctuation, prefix
ambiguity and preservation of member data.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document punctuation handling in name searches
commitResults.messageBody:
The guides describe whitespace-only name matching and reject
unprefixed slash keywords, which conflicts with the updated search
behavior.

Explain punctuation boundaries, complete compound matching and literal
punctuated queries. Clarify prefix selection and how to search for name
words that resemble supported field prefixes.

Update the search design and manual test instructions so users and
developers can verify consistent behavior across find, findall and
findany.
Clarify command parameter order in user guide

Name validation rejects ordinary name formats such as S/O and
O'Connor. Allow the punctuation identified in #203 while retaining
the length limit and rejecting punctuation-only values.

Add regression coverage for commands, imports, persistence, and
UI labels. Document the NUS and Myinfo basis for the accepted set.

Use a successful add to create JSON before the import-test backup.
Check that duplicate-tag rejection leaves JSON unchanged, then use
a successful edit to verify normalized tags are saved.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document duplicate email checks for new members
commitResults.messageBody:
The Developer Guide lacks a focused diagram explaining how duplicate
NUS emails affect member addition.

Add an activity diagram with guarded rejection and addition paths,
a merge node, and a high-level explanation of email identity checks.
Link persistence details to the existing save-recovery section.

Remove the command history class diagram and its references while
retaining the explanation of history behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove more test cases placeholder in DG

commitResults.messageBody:
The user stories table does not distinguish supported features
from future work.

Add implementation statuses, mark future work as planned, and
explain current limitations. Align the Markdown table columns
to make the requirements easier to review and maintain.

commitResults.messageTitle: Clarify spaces in the User Guide history example
Improve User Guide examples and Quick Start flow
commitResults.messageBody:
The guide mixes AB3 sample data with society examples, and Quick Start
commands can fail when the selected status view hides their targets.

Replace legacy examples with society names, addresses and tags. Adjust
the Quick Start command order and status views, clarify reused emails
across independent examples, and align sample tag ordering with the UI.
